_comment: Skripr SEO opportunity ledger AND learning memory. /seo-page reads this before building and appends a page entry after. /seo-review pulls real outcomes (GSC + PostHog) into each page's `actual`, compares to `predicted`, writes a `verdict`, and appends durable lessons to `learnings`, then recalibrates `scoring_method`. This is how the SEO agent self-improves: predictions are scored against reality every review cycle and the heuristics update.
scoring_method: Rank candidates by: (1) combined volume, (2) tool-intent (a generator beats a blog post), (3) low competition, (4) backed by an engine Skripr already ships, (5) tight product-to-funnel fit, (6) index-likelihood on a new domain. Tool pages index within 48h but earn GSC impressions slowly; guide/content pages earn impressions faster but convert less. Weight tool-intent pages higher for conversion, content pages higher for fast impression signals. /seo-review recalibrates these weights from observed outcomes; record any change here with a date and the evidence that drove it. Updated 2026-06-29: prior scoring over-pessimized indexLikelihoodWeeks for tool pages (predicted 8wk; actual <48h). Also: impression lag on tool pages is separate from indexing speed — indexed fast, ranking slowly. Updated 2026-07-06: impression lag for tool pages is faster than thought — first GSC signals appear in 7-10 days, not 4-8wk. Revise first-signal estimate to 1-2wk; meaningful volume still 4-8wk. New flag: any page 'unknown to Google' after 7+ days must be manually request-indexed AND given a direct inbound link from an already-indexed high-authority page (homepage or pillar). Do not rely on sitemap alone. Updated 2026-07-13: compare pages index same-day (faster than tool pages); confirmed /compare/skripr-vs-retti indexed within hours of deploy on 2026-07-10. Tool page lastCrawlTime is stagnant (all show 2026-06-28 despite 15+ days passing) — add inbound links from high-impression content pages to trigger Googlebot recrawls. Hub-outranking-spoke observed: /youtube-seo-tools at pos 8 for 'youtube tag generator free' while spoke sits at pos 77 — fix with explicit anchor-text links from hub to spoke. Updated 2026-07-20: inbound links added 2026-07-13 from highest-impression content page (demonetization guide, 53 impressions) to tool pages have NOT triggered a recrawl after 7 days. Internal links alone are insufficient on a new low-authority domain. External backlinks (Reddit, directories, Product Hunt) are the only real crawl-budget lever at this stage. Tool page impressions completely stagnant (zero new Jul 14-20). Near-top-10 positions emerging on content pages (niche-bend-examples pos 6.9, best-ai-tools-for-faceless-channels pos 6.2, grow-small-channel pos 10.8) — these are the closest-to-breakthrough pages and warrant internal-link attention. Updated 2026-07-27: the crawl-budget lull limits BREADTH, not just staleness — 17 of 18 Channel Name Generator niche spokes (49k/mo, low competition, the single highest-upside cluster on the domain) are still 'URL is unknown to Google' a full month after launch, despite verified sitemap entries and hub links to all 18. When shipping a large spoke set (10+ pages) on a low-authority domain, do NOT assume the sitemap will carry them all; budget for staggered manual request-indexing of the top few spokes at launch rather than shipping the full set and waiting. Also: the 'near-top-10 breakthrough' pages flagged 2026-07-20 did not continue climbing this cycle (niche-bend-examples 6.9->8.6, best-ai-tools-for-faceless-channels 6.2->8, grow-small-channel 10.8->11.4, all softened slightly). Correction: treat single-cycle sub-10 positions on <10-impression samples as noise, not momentum, until they hold or improve across 2+ consecutive cycles. Updated 2026-09-15: confirmed identical sitemap lastmod does not guarantee uniform recrawl across sibling pages (4 SEO Toolkit spokes share one lastmod, only 1 recrawled); and a recrawl alone is not evidence a fix worked, wait for actual impressions before declaring success.

pages[].verdict: null until first review; one of: winning | indexed-not-ranking | not-indexed | refresh-candidate | kill-candidate, plus a one-line why

schema.learnings[]: { date, lesson, evidence } durable, reusable heuristics proven by outcomes (e.g. 'tool pages index in ~3wk, guides ~8wk')

deferred_integrations.why_deferred: Own-page rankings already free via GSC (gsc-pull.py); ad-hoc competitor SERP/PAA already covered by WebSearch + firecrawl. The API only uniquely adds automated competitor SERP tracking at scale, which a young site does not need. Revisit only if doing systematic competitor rank tracking once pages are indexed and earning.

pages.verdict: 2026-10-01: no change (0 impressions, 0 clicks, no recrawl). | prior: indexed-not-ranking (day 79, zero recrawl despite sitemap fix): zero GSC impressions again. URL Inspection confirms Submitted and indexed but lastCrawlTime still 2026-06-28, unchanged even after the 2026-09-01 honest-lastmod sitemap fix landed and gave this page the same 2026-08-02 lastmod as youtube-title-generator (which DID get recrawled 2026-08-22). Same signal, no recrawl here: crawl budget selection on this domain is not purely lastmod-driven. No PostHog signup touches this window.

2026-10-01: still 'URL is unknown to Google', never crawled; no PostHog signup touch this window. Waiting on authority. | prior: not-indexed (79 days, persistent): still 'URL is unknown to Google', lastCrawlTime null, never crawled once. PostHog shows 1 signup touched this page before converting, so real demand keeps showing up with zero search visibility. Three request-index attempts already failed in prior cycles; per standing guidance, not spending more manual-request quota here. This is a crawl-budget/authority problem, not a submission problem.

2026-10-01: lastCrawlTime now 2026-09-17 (first recrawl since 06-28) but zero GSC impressions; a recrawl is not a result. Still indexed-not-ranking. | prior: indexed-not-ranking (signal fully decayed to zero, as predicted last cycle): impressions 4->0, page no longer appears in GSC at all. lastCrawlTime unchanged at 2026-06-28, 79 days stale, and NOT swept into the 2026-08-22 recrawl wave despite sharing title-generator's 2026-08-02 sitemap lastmod. Confirms: without an actual recrawl, positional signal does not just decline, it disappears.

2026-10-01: no change (0 impressions, 0 clicks, no recrawl). | prior: indexed-not-ranking (recrawl did not convert to ranking, 24 days later): the 2026-08-22 recrawl triggered by the sitemap fix has produced zero new GSC impressions; lastCrawlTime still 2026-08-22, no further recrawl since. The pre-recrawl signal (4 impressions, avgPosition 5.0 as of 2026-07-27) has fully rolled off with nothing replacing it. 1 PostHog signup touched this page. Lesson: a recrawl is not itself validation of the sitemap fix, only fresh impressions are. Watch one more cycle before calling this closed.

2026-10-01: no change (0 impressions, 0 clicks, no recrawl). | prior: indexed-not-ranking (unchanged, now 79 days stale): zero GSC impressions, no change since last recorded cycle. lastCrawlTime still 2026-06-28; also not swept into the title-generator recrawl despite an identical sitemap lastmod. Same crawl-budget-lull pattern as hook-generator and tag-generator.

2026-10-01: no change (0 impressions, 0 clicks, no recrawl). | prior: indexed-not-ranking (breadth completely stalled, 7 weeks flat): hub still zero GSC impressions, lastCrawlTime unchanged at 2026-06-28. Re-inspected all 18 niche spokes: still exactly 5/18 indexed (gaming, tech, finance, faceless, sports, all crawled 2026-07-27) and 13/18 'URL is unknown to Google', identical to the 2026-07-27 finding with zero movement either direction in 7 weeks. Per standing guidance, not spending manual-request quota on the thin spokes; this cluster's breadth is now clearly gated on domain authority, not linking or submission.

2026-10-01: no change (0 impressions, 0 clicks, no recrawl). | prior: indexed-not-ranking (67 days since indexing, zero recrawls, longest freeze of any tracked page): lastCrawlTime still 2026-07-10, unchanged since it first indexed same-day. Zero GSC impressions the entire time. Unlike the tool pages this page has no scheduled content refresh to bump its lastmod, so it has no mechanism to attract a recrawl. Watch item: if still frozen with zero signal next cycle, treat as a kill-candidate rather than continuing to hold it as indexed-not-ranking.

2026-10-01: no change (0 impressions, 0 clicks, no recrawl). | prior: indexed-not-ranking (mixed signal, treat as noise): impressions ticked down 2->1 but avgPosition improved sharply 50->10 on a 1-impression sample. lastCrawlTime unchanged at 2026-08-02, no new recrawl. Per the standing discipline against over-reading single-cycle moves on tiny samples, this needs to hold or improve across 2+ consecutive cycles before it counts as real momentum. Still the only tracked page trending toward page 1 at all.

learnings.lesson: Indexing is faster than the 'weeks to months' default for content pages: 19 pages had GSC impressions by ~day 3 post-launch (homepage, /youtube-strategy guides, /compare pages). Do not over-pessimize indexLikelihoodWeeks for guides/comparison pages.
learnings.evidence: GSC searchAnalytics 28d pull 2026-06-28: 19 pages with impressions, ~118 total impressions, 2 clicks (homepage, niche-bend-examples).

learnings.lesson: Tool pages (tag/title/description/channel-name generators) had ZERO impressions while guides did, despite being live since 2026-06-27. Tool pages appear to index slower or need stronger internal links. Front-load homepage/pillar internal links AND manual GSC indexing for every new tool page; do not assume the hub link alone is enough.
learnings.evidence: Same pull: no /youtube-*-generator or /youtube-channel-name-generator URLs present in GSC results.

learnings.lesson: Tool pages indexed within 24-48h of deploy — much faster than the 8-week conservative prediction. URL Inspection API (Submitted and indexed) confirmed /youtube-tag-generator, /youtube-title-generator, /youtube-description-generator, /youtube-channel-name-generator, and /youtube-hook-generator all crawled 2026-06-28. Correct future indexLikelihoodWeeks for tool pages with homepage internal links from 8 to 1-2wk.
learnings.evidence: URL Inspection API batch check 2026-06-29; all 5 tool pages showed 'Submitted and indexed' with lastCrawlTime 2026-06-28T22:xx:xxZ.

learnings.lesson: Indexing speed and impression speed are separate. Tool pages index fast (48h) but earn zero GSC impressions while guide/content pages earn impressions within days. Indexed does not mean ranking. For a new domain, expect 4-8wk before tool pages show GSC signals; content pages earn impressions faster via long-tail crawl queries. Do not confuse 'indexed-not-ranking' for a tool page failure — it is normal and expected.
learnings.evidence: GSC 28d pull 2026-06-29: 20 pages with impressions, all are content/guide/comparison/standalone pages; zero generator tool pages despite URL Inspection confirming them indexed. niche-bend-examples and homepage are the only click-earners.

learnings.lesson: Two pages are 'URL is unknown to Google' despite the site being live: /youtube-video-ideas-generator and /youtube-video-ideas (a pillar page). For any new page, verify sitemap entry AND homepage/pillar footer links exist before assuming Google will find it. The sitemap alone is not enough — the crawler follows links, and a pillar with no inbound link from an already-indexed page may be missed.
learnings.evidence: URL Inspection API 2026-06-29: /youtube-video-ideas-generator and /youtube-video-ideas both returned verdict=NEUTRAL, coverageState='URL is unknown to Google'.

learnings.lesson: Tool pages earn first GSC impressions within 7-10 days on a new domain (not 4-8wk). /youtube-tag-generator (5 impressions, pos 77) and /youtube-title-generator (4 impressions, pos 5.0) both showed signals by day 9. Impression lag prediction was over-pessimistic — update expectation to 1-2wk for first signals, 4-8wk for meaningful volume.
learnings.evidence: GSC 28d pull 2026-07-06: /youtube-tag-generator pos 77, /youtube-title-generator pos 5.0, both live since 2026-06-27.

learnings.lesson: /youtube-title-generator at position 5 after 9 days is an anomalous strong signal — likely ranking for long-tail zero-competition variants of the keyword. When a new-domain page shows sub-10 position that early, prioritize it for internal links and watch for click data in the next cycle.
learnings.evidence: GSC 28d pull 2026-07-06: /youtube-title-generator avgPosition 5.0, 4 impressions, 0 clicks. Domain launched 2026-06-25, page live since 2026-06-27.

learnings.lesson: CORRECTED (was: 'action list not executed'): the 2026-06-29 request-index batch WAS executed but GSC silently dropped half of it. 5/10 URLs show 'Submitted and indexed'; 5/10 (incl. /youtube-video-ideas and /youtube-video-ideas-generator) show 'unknown to Google' with no fetch attempt. Internal links were NOT the problem: homepage + pillar links and sitemap entries verified present in served HTML, pages return 200. Rule: GSC's request button can rate-limit mid-session without an error, so verify every submitted URL via the URL Inspection API within a few days and re-request the ones that did not take.
learnings.evidence: URL Inspection API 2026-07-06 across the full Jun-29 batch: adjacent-niches/ctr-optimization/adsense-requirements/how-to-use-ai/first-1000-subs = Submitted and indexed; the other 5 = unknown. curl verified hrefs and sitemap entries live.

learnings.lesson: Index-status classification must use EXACT coverageState strings: 'Discovered - currently not indexed' and 'Crawled - currently not indexed' contain the word 'indexed' but mean NOT indexed. A substring match inflated earlier audits (reported ~50-52 indexed; true count was 48). Corrected baseline 2026-07-06: 48/80 Submitted-and-indexed, 9 Discovered-queued (normal crawl-queue state for a young domain, shrank 14->9 in a week, no fix needed), 23 unknown (17 = long-tail name spokes, expected). 'Discovered - not indexed' needs NO validate-fix action; it drains with domain trust, links, and time.
learnings.evidence: Full-sitemap URL Inspection audit 2026-07-06 with exact-status buckets, cross-checked against the GSC coverage report (dated 6/29, showed 14 Discovered).

learnings.lesson: GSC silent rate-limit confirmed again: /youtube-video-ideas-generator is still 'URL is unknown to Google' 14+ days after supposed request-indexing — despite 200 response, correct canonical, no noindex, sitemap entry, and homepage href all verified in served HTML. All on-page signals correct. The only remaining explanation is GSC silently dropped the submission. Rule: treat every request-index action as unconfirmed until verified via URL Inspection API within 48h. Re-request any that show NEUTRAL/unknown.
learnings.evidence: URL Inspection API 2026-07-13: coverageState 'URL is unknown to Google', robots.txt UNSPECIFIED (never fetched). curl confirmed homepage link and sitemap entry present. robots.txt allows all. Page returns 200.

learnings.lesson: Tool pages (indexed 2026-06-28) have not been recrawled by Google in 15+ days — all show lastCrawlTime 2026-06-28 in URL Inspection. Indexed but stale. On a young domain with low authority, Googlebot deprioritizes recrawling static tool pages unless triggered. Tactic: add inbound links from already-ranking content pages (e.g. the demonetization guide at pos 18) to the tool pages; fresh link graph signals prompt recrawls.
learnings.evidence: URL Inspection API 2026-07-13: /youtube-hook-generator, /youtube-description-generator, /youtube-channel-name-generator all show lastCrawlTime 2026-06-28T22:xx:xxZ despite being live for 15 days.

learnings.lesson: Hub-outranking-spoke detected: /youtube-seo-tools hub appeared at position 8 for 'youtube tag generator free' while its spoke /youtube-tag-generator sits at position 77 for the same query. The hub is stealing authority that should flow to the spoke. Fix: add an explicit internal link with anchor text 'YouTube Tag Generator' from the hub to the spoke, and check that the hub does not use the same H1/title as the spoke.
learnings.evidence: GSC 28d pull 2026-07-13: /youtube-seo-tools pos 8 for 'youtube tag generator free' (1 impression); /youtube-tag-generator pos 77 for the same query (4 impressions on that query).

learnings.lesson: Compare pages are the fastest-indexing page type on this domain: /compare/skripr-vs-retti went from deploy to 'Submitted and indexed' in under 6 hours (built 2026-07-10, lastCrawlTime 2026-07-10T17:21:16Z). Faster than tool pages (48h) and guides (1-3 days). Compare pages may have lower competition signals that make Google crawl them immediately. Implication: if rapid indexing is needed (e.g. to capture a trend), a compare page is the fastest entry point.
learnings.evidence: URL Inspection API 2026-07-13: /compare/skripr-vs-retti verdict=PASS, coverageState='Submitted and indexed', lastCrawlTime 2026-07-10T17:21:16Z. Page was built and deployed 2026-07-10.

learnings.lesson: CORRECTION to the 'GSC silent drop' theory: the root cause of /youtube-video-ideas and /youtube-video-ideas-generator never indexing is a CRAWL-BUDGET LULL, not dropped requests. URL Inspection shows lastCrawlTime NULL for both (never crawled) while every linking page was crawled only during a single Jun 23-28 initial wave (homepage Jun 23, hub/pillars Jun 26-27, tool pages Jun 28) and NOT since. A new low-authority domain gets one crawl pass then Google rations budget hard; pages missed in that pass, plus any later edits (e.g. the Jul 6 anchor-text fix), sit unseen. Re-requesting via GSC is low-yield here because requests queue behind near-zero crawl budget. The real levers: (1) inbound links from the MOST-crawled page (highest-impression content = most revisited: the demonetization guide at 53 imp) to pull crawler to orphans, done 2026-07-13; (2) backlinks/authority to raise overall crawl budget (directory + Reddit work, in progress). Do NOT keep re-requesting; it has failed 3x for these two.
learnings.evidence: URL Inspection 2026-07-13: both pages coverageState 'URL is unknown to Google', lastCrawlTime null, crawledAs null, canonical self-correct, robots allow-all, Googlebot UA gets 200, both in sitemap and linked from indexed pages. Linking pages' lastCrawl all Jun 23-28. Retti (new page Jul 10, linked from vidiq) crawled same-day, proving new-URL discovery still works when the crawler reaches a linking page.

learnings.lesson: Inbound links from high-impression content pages do NOT trigger tool-page recrawls within 7 days on a low-authority domain. Links added 2026-07-13 from the demonetization guide (53 impressions, pos 18) have not caused any tool page recrawl as of 2026-07-20 — all tool pages still show lastCrawlTime 2026-06-28 (22 days stale). Internal links are necessary but not sufficient; they have a much longer lag than expected on a young domain. External backlinks (Reddit, directories, Product Hunt) that attract fresh Googlebot visits are the only proven crawl-budget lever at this stage.
learnings.evidence: URL Inspection API 2026-07-20: /youtube-hook-generator, /youtube-description-generator, /youtube-channel-name-generator, /youtube-tag-generator, /youtube-title-generator all still show lastCrawlTime 2026-06-28T22:xx:xxZ despite homepage links present since Jun 28 and additional guide-page links added Jul 13.

learnings.lesson: Tool page impressions are completely stagnant: /youtube-tag-generator (5 imp, pos 77) and /youtube-title-generator (4 imp, pos 5) show identical numbers in the 28d windows ending Jul 13 and Jul 20. Zero new impressions in the Jul 14-20 period. Pages that are indexed but not recrawled in 22+ days will not earn new impressions. Recrawl is the prerequisite for impression growth on tool pages; without it, the early signals are the only data and they do not compound.
learnings.evidence: GSC 28d pull 2026-07-20 vs 2026-07-13: tag-generator 5 imp pos 77 unchanged, title-generator 4 imp pos 5 unchanged. Rolling window advanced 7 days but totals did not change, confirming zero new impressions in the Jul 14-20 window.

learnings.lesson: Near-top-10 positions emerging on content pages: /youtube-strategy/niche-bend-examples at pos 6.9 (12 impressions), /best-ai-tools-for-faceless-channels at pos 6.2 (6 impressions), /best/ai-tools-for-youtube-automation at pos 7.7 (3 impressions), /youtube-strategy/how-to-grow-a-small-youtube-channel at pos 10.8 (8 impressions). These are the closest-to-breakthrough pages on the domain. Each one is within reach of top-5 clicks with a content refresh or stronger internal-link signal. Prioritize internal links to these pages from the homepage and other high-impression guides.
learnings.evidence: GSC 28d pull 2026-07-20: multiple content/roundup pages at sub-11 avg position with growing impression counts.

learnings.lesson: CORRECTION to the 2026-07-20 'near-top-10 breakthrough' read: none of the four flagged pages continued climbing. niche-bend-examples went 6.9->8.6 (12->5 impressions), best-ai-tools-for-faceless-channels went 6.2->8 (6->3 impressions), how-to-grow-a-small-youtube-channel went 10.8->11.4 (8->5 impressions); only ai-tools-for-youtube-automation held flat (7.7, 3 impressions both cycles). Treat single-cycle sub-10 positions on small (<10) impression samples as noisy, not momentum. Only flag a page as 'breaking through' after it holds or improves across 2+ consecutive review cycles.
learnings.evidence: GSC 28d pull 2026-07-27 vs 2026-07-20: all four previously-flagged pages compared side by side, three declined in both position and impressions, one unchanged, none improved.

learnings.lesson: The crawl-budget lull limits BREADTH of a launch, not just staleness of already-indexed pages. URL Inspection on all 18 Channel Name Generator niche spokes (49k/mo cluster, the single highest-upside cluster on the domain) shows 17 of 18 still 'URL is unknown to Google' a full month after launch; only /sports indexed (2026-06-29). Verified via curl that all 18 are in the sitemap and linked from the hub, so this is not a wiring bug. Lesson: shipping a large spoke set (10+ pages) in one launch on a low-authority domain gets roughly one page crawled per wave; future large spoke launches should lead with manual request-indexing of the 3-5 highest-volume spokes rather than shipping the full set and relying on the sitemap.
learnings.evidence: URL Inspection API 2026-07-27 across all 18 /youtube-channel-name-generator/* spokes: 17 returned coverageState 'URL is unknown to Google' with lastCrawlTime null; only 'sports' returned 'Submitted and indexed' (lastCrawlTime 2026-06-29). curl confirmed all 18 present in sitemap.xml and linked from the hub page's served HTML.

learnings.lesson: /youtube-title-generator has now held avgPosition exactly 5.0 across three consecutive 28-day windows (Jul 13, Jul 20, Jul 27) despite zero recrawl in 29 days. An initial strong position appears to persist without a recrawl; recrawl seems to matter for reaching new queries/impressions, not for retaining an already-earned position. Prioritize this page for backlinks over a recrawl push, since the ranking floor looks secure and the missing piece is discovery volume.
learnings.evidence: GSC 28d pulls 2026-07-13, 2026-07-20, 2026-07-27: avgPosition 5.0 in all three, 4 impressions in all three, lastCrawlTime unchanged at 2026-06-28T22:26:55Z across the same span.

learnings.lesson: Tool-page impression totals decay as old signal ages out of the rolling 28-day window rather than holding flat. /youtube-tag-generator's original pos-77/5-impression signal (from the one-time June 28 crawl) dropped to pos 95.8/4 impressions this cycle as the earliest data points exited the 28d window with nothing new to replace them. A single crawl event produces one batch of decaying signal, not a stable baseline; only a fresh recrawl resets the clock. Time alone erodes a stagnant tool page rather than helping it.
learnings.evidence: GSC 28d pulls 2026-07-20 vs 2026-07-27: /youtube-tag-generator impressions 5->4, avgPosition 77->95.8, with lastCrawlTime unchanged at 2026-06-28 across both pulls.

learnings.lesson: Keyword Planner API is LIVE; ALWAYS verify real avg_monthly_searches before building. Real volumes ran 10-20x below the old estimates (hook generator 10/mo, channel name gen 2400 not 49k, SEO toolkit ~7k not 99k, transcript-for-youtube 110k). Estimates are no longer acceptable for go/no-go.
learnings.evidence: Keyword Planner live run 2026-07-27/08-02.

learnings.lesson: Re-targeting an already-indexed page to a broader head term is the cheapest win: move the broader term to H1+title, demote the exact-match to H2+body, keep URL/canonical, fold in adjacent intents from the data. No new page, no re-index risk.
learnings.evidence: Name generator retargeted 2400->5400/mo cluster 2026-08-02.

learnings.lesson: Check whether a page uses the SYNONYM its audience searches. A page can be on-topic yet invisible for the larger half of its cluster because it never says the other word (/faceless-youtube had 0 'youtube automation', a 3600/mo term bigger than the 2400 it targeted). Fix is on-page vocabulary.
learnings.evidence: 0 -> 33 'youtube automation' mentions on /faceless-youtube.

learnings.lesson: Serverless: a bare fire-and-forget promise in a FAST route is killed when the response returns. Use Next after() from 'next/server' for post-response side effects. The transcript tool's learning-capture silently never ran until switched to after().
learnings.evidence: Test video aircAruvnKk appeared in viral_frameworks only after after() switch.

learnings.lesson: ATTRIBUTION: the 4 name spokes that indexed (gaming/tech/finance/faceless, all crawled 2026-07-27) are exactly the 4 hand-requested on 2026-07-06, not random organic expansion. Manual request-indexing works on never-crawled URLs (~3wk lag); do NOT read spoke movement as backlinks landing.
learnings.evidence: gaming/tech/finance/faceless crawled 07-27; cooking/prank still unknown.

learnings.lesson: CORRECTION: /youtube-title-generator's 'durable pos 5.0 across 3 cycles' was an artifact, not durability. It was the same single 2026-06-28 crawl's data sitting in the rolling 28d window; it dropped to zero when that crawl aged out. Do not call a position durable without a fresh crawl behind it.
learnings.evidence: pos 5.0 held 3 cycles then zeroed; lastCrawl frozen at 2026-06-28 the whole time.

learnings.lesson: The sitemap honest-lastmod fix WORKS (validated): /youtube-title-generator was recrawled 2026-08-22, the day the fix went live, after 55 days frozen, and it was the stale tool page with the most recent honest lastmod (08-02) while older-dated pages were left alone. Newest-lastmod-first recrawl is exactly the predicted behavior.
learnings.evidence: URL Inspection: /youtube-title-generator lastCrawl moved 2026-06-28 -> 2026-08-22. Confirmed by owner screenshot.

learnings.lesson: CRITICAL PROCESS FIX: fixes deployed via `vercel deploy` but NOT git-committed are fragile and WILL silently regress. The sitemap fix (deployed 2026-08-22) was reverted when a later working-tree operation restored the committed old file, and a subsequent deploy shipped new Date() back to prod, undoing a fix that had already worked. Re-applied and git-committed 2026-09-01 (commit e284312, sitemap.ts only). RULE: any durable code fix must be git-committed, not just deployed. This whole project has run on an uncommitted working tree (deploys via vercel only); that is the root fragility. Consider committing the SEO surface. Separately: `tsc --noEmit` locally flags scripts/*.test.ts errors that Next's build IGNORES, so the strict 'tsc exit 0' pre-deploy gate over-reports; trust the actual vercel build result for test-file-only errors.
learnings.evidence: Working tree sitemap.ts found reverted to new Date(); prod sitemap.xml showed 50 URLs all dated 2026-09-02; after re-apply+commit+deploy, prod shows 9 distinct honest dates. Deploy succeeded despite 7 scripts/*.test.ts tsc errors.

learnings.lesson: Identical sitemap lastmod does not guarantee synchronized recrawl on this domain.
learnings.evidence: hook/tag/title/description all carry the same 2026-08-02 lastmod entry in sitemap.ts (SeoToolPage cross-link change), but only youtube-title-generator was recrawled (2026-08-22, confirmed via URL Inspection 2026-09-15); the other 3 remain frozen at 2026-06-28 seven weeks later.

learnings.lesson: A recrawl does not itself validate a sitemap/indexing fix; only new impressions do.
learnings.evidence: youtube-title-generator recrawled 2026-08-22 but produced zero GSC impressions in the following 24 days (checked 2026-09-15); its pre-recrawl position-5 signal from 2026-07-27 fully rolled off with nothing replacing it.

learnings.lesson: Channel Name Generator spoke breadth needs external authority, not more internal signal; internal linking and sitemap presence alone have not moved it in 7 weeks.
learnings.evidence: Re-inspected all 18 niche spokes 2026-09-15: exactly the same 5/18 indexed as found 2026-07-27 (gaming, tech, finance, faceless, sports), 13/18 still 'URL is unknown to Google', zero change either direction across the interval despite all 18 being in the sitemap and linked from the hub the entire time.

learnings.lesson: Technical audit (sitemap crawl of all 83 URLs): clean on status/noindex/canonical/titles/descriptions, but the homepage had NO H1 (hero was a styled div) and 18 name-generator spokes were ~278-word near-identical templates. Fixed: homepage hero is now an h1; the 13 never-crawled spokes are noindex,follow and removed from the sitemap (scaled-content risk per the Aug 2026 spam update), keeping the 5 indexed ones via INDEXABLE_NICHE_IDS. Rule: don't ship large near-identical programmatic sets on a low-authority domain; a spoke must have genuinely unique content before it is indexable. Also: FAQ rich results are limited to gov/health sites since 2023, so FAQPage schema is not a click benefit here.
learnings.evidence: Audit 2026-10-01: h1 count 0 on /; spokes avg 278 words. After deploy: / has 1 h1; /cooking robots 'noindex, follow' still 200; sitemap lists 5 spokes; 9 distinct honest lastmods preserved.
